## Services

- Reels and short-form video for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.
- Videography for restaurants, events, property, products, creators, and local brands.
- Photography for portraits, lifestyle, event, commercial, and product use.
- Drone and aerial visuals where rules, weather, and site conditions allow.
- Editing and color for video, plus photo editing, culling, and retouching.

## Service Areas

- Fort Lauderdale: Las Olas, Flagler Village, Victoria Park, Wilton Manors, Rio Vista.
- Broward County: Hollywood, Pompano Beach, Davie, Plantation, Coral Springs, Sunrise, Weston.
- Miami-Dade: Brickell, Wynwood, Doral, Coral Gables, Miami Beach.

## Proof Policy

The site should only publish real Esteban work, real Instagram permalinks, real testimonials, and real client examples. Placeholders are labeled until real media is available. No fake testimonials, borrowed client logos, or guaranteed views/rankings.
